svg.title: Aeris Zhu, building OMO
svg.desc: Hi, I’m Aeris, building OMO for everyday creativity. In this surprising yet deeply chaotic AI era, everything is accelerating, and everything is becoming cheap. Still, we believe in the value of a good tool, one that serves as an extension of the person rather than a replacement. We want to quietly build things that last. ooooomo.com
